local: applyWorkshop synchronously knows original command/id and exact before/after inventory; current private dispatch returns only ok/message. Extend a presentation result from the same successful pure action, not a global revision watcher.
shared: Store locks the player, applies gather and persists immutable result keyed by command UUID/payload. Replayed result includes current snapshot, which can contain intervening changes. selectedDesign: Reserve modal art/status/retry dimensions from initial render. Announce literal result once; art is decorative. Use original command/player/resource/panel/rig scope and a positive exact grant. Keep text on missing/failed/late art; no late replay.

futureAuthorityRequirements: Compute grant from locked original before/after operation, persist in existing immutable result transaction; never accept quantity from client.

SSE/passive updates never trigger receipts. UI/animation completion never writes inventory, starts another command or delays authority.
